claims.claim: Default OMEGA_CI_PUBLIC_REPOS is empty: public-repository jobs are refused (reason public_not_opted_in) with no GitHub call, and private-repository behaviour is unchanged.
For an opted-in public repository, a same-repo push run launches exactly one runner, and the run lookup precedes the JIT config call.

Fork pull_request, pull_request_target, other events, run 404, lookup errors (500, 401, transport, non-object body) are refused fail-closed and emit omega.ci.runner.refused with a reason; errors are not cached.
One run lookup per workflow run (concurrent jobs share the in-flight lookup; later jobs use the cached verdict); restart replay re-verifies saved public jobs.
Whole ci_runners suite, ruff, format, mypy, pyright (polyglot), docs/env-inventory tests pass.
Greptile round 1 P2: head_repository.fork must be an explicit false; missing, null or non-boolean fork is refused as head_unknown.

Pre-fix controller (HEAD 79b857d controller.py): the new tests fail. A job finishing during its run lookup leaves demand and launches; a public queued event after completed launches; a restart mid-lookup loses the accepted job.
Greptile P1 (stale demand): a queued event after in_progress/completed, or one whose job advanced during the lookup, is ignored; no runner is launched and the queue stays empty.
Greptile P1 (restart): an accepted public job is on disk before its lookup, replays after a restart mid-lookup, is re-verified (run lookup before JIT) and served; a refused one is removed.

Greptile P1 (refused forks get runners): the runner-side pre-job hook refuses non-allowlisted repos, pull_request_target, fork/other-repo/unknown-head pull requests, and non-allowlisted events for non-private repos, failing closed on missing or unparseable data; the shipped script refuses under a hostile PYTHONPATH (-I); the agent sets ACTIONS_RUNNER_HOOK_JOB_STARTED itself in the child env and writes the root-owned policy; Dockerfile pins are asserted intact.

unverified: No live public-repo webhook against GitHub: behaviour is exercised in-process with fake transports (no sockets).
Full omega_prime/tests suite not re-run; only ci_runners, docs, public-repo and env-inventory tests.
Controller not started on the VPS (held: runner group omega-ci missing, github-pat file not written).

The pre-job hook has not run inside a real actions/runner on the built image (no image build here: heavy, and the Railway deploy is an operator step). The shipped script runs in tests with only its interpreter, module and policy paths rewritten; the Dockerfile runs it once at build and requires a refusal.
OMEGA_CI_AGENT_REPOS is not yet set on the Railway Desktop service. Until it is, a redeployed image fails every job closed (operator step).
contract_changes: New optional env OMEGA_CI_PUBLIC_REPOS (subset of OMEGA_CI_REPOS, default empty).
New event omega.ci.runner.refused {job_id, run_id, repo, reason}.
demand.json entries gain a 'public' boolean; older files load as non-public unless private is false and visibility public.

Desktop agent: new OMEGA_CI_AGENT_REPOS (required for jobs to run), OMEGA_CI_AGENT_JOB_HOOK, OMEGA_CI_AGENT_JOB_POLICY; the image sets the latter two and every runner gets ACTIONS_RUNNER_HOOK_JOB_STARTED.
Controller: queued after in_progress/completed for the same job id is acknowledged and ignored (bounded memory 4096); pending-lookup public jobs are included in demand.json.
rollback_plan: Revert the PR. With OMEGA_CI_PUBLIC_REPOS unset the controller matches main except that stale queued redeliveries are ignored. Reverting also removes the Desktop pre-job hook; no host or Railway change was made by this PR.
